argument: The strongest attempt rests a 'keeps' reading on the conservation law explicitly present (energy is conserved overall), since conservation laws keep their shape. It fails: the statement also records one cost, two vibrations coexisting at one location, flagged as a separation made by distance, and an odd number of such costs turns around; that conservation is kept inside the turned sentence, as the majority reading did. No rule-compliant 'keeps' reading of the whole relation exists.
